title: Lead Sales Engineering Specialist - Security
description:
From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran , customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
About the Role
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
We’re looking for a talented Sales Engineering Specialist - Security to join our global sales engineering specialist team. As a Sales Engineering Specialist focused on Security, you will work closely with our sales and field sales engineering teams to satisfy customers’ security needs. You will be responsible for providing timely responses to security questionnaires, engaging in customer-facing infosec calls, and collaborating with our internal SRE and Product teams focused on ensuring Fivetran ’s platform security.
Technologies You’ll Use
In this role, you will be expected to have a strong understanding of the following technologies:

•
Fivetran 's data integration platform, deployment methods, and security features

• Cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform

• Security technologies such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, data loss prevention systems, and encryption

• Containerization and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker, and familiarity with hybrid and self-hosted deployment models

• Security and Data Privacy Compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, HIPAA, HITRUST and GDPR

What You’ll Do

• Support our sales and field sales engineering teams with deep technical knowledge and understanding of Fivetran ’s internal security operations, related platform features, and the security domain

• Deliver timely and accurate responses to prospect and customer security questionnaires utilizing internal tooling

• Work with Legal and AppSec to maintain internal libraries for use in security questionnaires

• Lead documentation and internal enablement efforts, helping to scale our specialist knowledge to the entire department

• Work closely with Fivetran ’s Product and Engineering teams to ensure alignment of our solutions to our customer needs

• Engage directly with prospects and customers on security architecture reviews and compliance discussions, with increasing ownership over time

• Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and trends in the security domain

Skills We’re Looking For

• 3+ years as a security administrator, backend engineer, field CISO, or IT services within an enterprise or similarly com

title: After Hours Maintenance Service Tech - REMOTE
description:
UDR , Inc. is now hiring an After Hours Maintenance Service Tech to join our team.
This position is fully remote: CA, CO, FL, MD, MA, NJ, NY, TX, VA, WA, DC

GENERAL SUMMARY OF DUTIES: Position provides after-hours maintenance customer service to residents of a UDR community, specific to emergency service issues. The incumbent may receive incoming calls from multiple communities’ residents and will be responsible for diagnosing and/or troubleshooting service issues, determining the priority and urgency of the issue in areas such as HVAC, boiler systems, electrical, plumbing, and appliances. Position will be held to high standards of exemplary customer service and will be accountable for communication between residents and on-site teams to ensure best guest experience possible
SUPERVISION RECEIVED: Reports to the After-Hours Maintenance Call Center Supervisor
SUPERVISION EXERCISED: N/A
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
1.Respond to resident calls for emergency maintenance by asking appropriate questions to understand and/or troubleshoot severity of issue being reported.
2.Follow designated flow charts to determine what qualifies as an emergency.
3.Direct resident on how to resolve issues as a self-service item whenever appropriate and possible.
4.Determine which vendor, if any, will be contacted to resolve the service problem being reported.
5.Act as a liaison for UDR to contact responsible and appropriate service vendor to arrange for their deployment to community.
6.Track any billable time.
7.Submit all corresponding service requests and communicate related information to the community.
8.Identify and clearly communicate to the resident the service work that will need to be completed by the site team during normal business hours.
9.Submit service requests for any calls that were determined not to be an emergency in the property management and service software as needed.
10.Schedule PM tasks such as backflow testing, Boiler maintenance, etc. for assigned communities
11.Schedule and create PO’s for vender related services.
12.Audit service requests and invoices.
13.Provide exemplary customer service to both internal and external customers.
14.Identify strategic opportunities to enhance customer service experience and streamline process.
15.Perform other duties as assigned or as necessary.

PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS:

• Knowledge of organizational and community policies and procedures. Ability to apply policies and procedures to solve everyday issues. Knowledge of and ability to follow proper safety techniques in accordance with Company, community, OSHA, EPA, and departmental policies, procedures and standards. Must have knowledge and experience with electrical, HVAC, plumbing, carpentry, and appliance repair.

• Demonstrated ability to understand and comprehend instructions. Immediately report any mechanical or electrical equipment malfunctions, associate/resident/visitor injuries or accidents, or other safety issues to the appropriate individual(s). Ability to proactively recognize and implement superior customer service to internal and external customers. Must know and follow the Fair Housing laws.

• Ability to exercise initiative and problem-solving skills. Proven exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to work in an autonomous, self-directed environment. Competent, organized, professional. Demonstrated success in working as part of a larger team, in conjunction with Company managers, vendors, prospective renters, residents, and associates.

• Ability to respond to questions or resolve resident, vendor, contractor or work scheduling issues. Must have effective listening communication skills. Ability to use a computer, a smart phone, and enter service ticket information into the system. Demonstrated proficiency with MS Office software applications such as Microsoft Office, Word and Excel.

title: Growth Marketing Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 YOUR MISSION: BUILD OUR GROWTH ENGINE

As Growth Marketing Manager, you own voize's full-funnel demand engine, from the first touchpoint to Sales-ready pipeline. Your mission is to build a repeatable, data-driven growth motion that turns brand awareness into qualified leads and converts them into revenue, connecting every campaign to business impact, and helping voize grow in a measurable way.

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS - NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE

- Own paid acquisition (LinkedIn, Meta): from strategy to execution, optimizing for pipeline quality and CAC

- Build and run the growth experimentation roadmap: A/B tests on landing pages, forms, CTAs, and nurture flows

- Manage and improve lead nurture programs in HubSpot: segmentation, scoring, lifecycle stages, re-engagement

- Own campaign reporting and attribution partner with RevOps to ensure accurate pipeline tracking

- Collaborate closely with Sales (SDRs, AEs) on lead quality, ICP alignment, and pipeline targets

🤝 YOUR SKILLSET - WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- Several years in demand gen, growth marketing, or full-funnel B2B marketing, ideally in SaaS or tech

- Hands-on experience with paid social, especially LinkedIn and Meta, from campaign setup to optimization

- Strong HubSpot knowledge: workflows, lead scoring, lifecycle stages, nurture programs, segmentation, and reporting

- Strong analytical mindset: you are comfortable with data, attribution, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, and making decisions from it

- Experimentation-first thinking: you have run A/B tests, documented learnings, and iterated based on results

- AI-native mindset: you actively look for opportunities to automate repetitive work, build workflows, and know to use Claude co-work / Claude code to move faster and smarter

- Ability to partner closely with Sales on lead quality, ICP alignment, MQL criteria, and pipeline targets

- Fluent German AND English (our core market is DACH, most content is German)

🌱 GROWING TOGETHER - WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT VOIZE

- Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

- We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

- We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events at our Berlin office, we offer hybrid work for this role with dedicated remote working days across the EU & the UK

- Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses

- You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up. We work 3 days from the office. You choose the days.

✨ READY TO TALK? APPLY NOW! 🚀

We look forward to your application and can’t wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

title: Senior Help Desk Technician
description:
Marathon Health is a leading advanced primary care provider, partnering with employer and union plan sponsors to improve health for millions of Americans. With nationwide onsite, nearsite, and network health centers, and virtual primary care, Marathon delivers a value-based model that enhances the healthcare experience for members and providers, while driving meaningful cost savings for plan sponsors. Marathon is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting the company's commitment to building an inclusive, high-trust culture where all employees can thrive. Learn more at
ABOUT THE JOB
The Senior Help Desk Tech provides advanced technical support for hardware, software applications, operating systems, and networking issues, with a strong focus on customer service and efficient problem resolution. The Senior Technician serves as an escalation point for complex service requests and incidents that cannot be resolved at the first level.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

• Diagnosing and resolving advanced technical issues across multiple platforms and environments, including computers, servers, peripherals, and network components.

• Acting as a technical lead for escalated support cases, ensuring timely resolution and root cause.

• Collaborating with Tier 1 technicians to provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

• Documenting solutions and contributing to the knowledge base to improve team efficiency and reduce repeat incidents.

• Coordinating with other Technology teams (e.g., infrastructure, clinical application support, Security) to resolve cross-functional issues.

• Meet or exceed required Service Level Agreements for issue resolution

• Participate in After-Hours On-Call Rotation

• Strict adherence to all IT Policies and Procedures (including HIPAA, PCI Compliance, and Hi Trust)

QUALIFICATIONS
Associate's Degree in Information Technology and a minimum of 5 years’ experience in technical support, help desk operations, IT service management, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Familiarity with incident tracking systems and ticketing platforms (e.g., Freshservice, ADO, or Jira). Proven ability to troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues in a corporate or enterprise environment. CompTIA A + and or Network + - Preferred.
DESIRED ATTRIBUTES

• Background in ITIL practices - especially incident management

• Industry experiences supporting a healthcare environment

• Experience training or mentoring junior IT staff

• Experience working in a customer-facing role, providing technical assistance and resolving user issues.

• Demonstrates strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority tasks under pressure while maintaining service level agreements and response times.

• Works independently with minimal supervision, while also contributing effectively to team-based troubleshooting and knowledge sharing.

• Communicates technical concepts clearly and professionally across all levels of the organization, both verbally and in writing, including documentation and user guidance.

• Accurately distinguishes between Tier 1 and Tier 2 issues, applying sound judgment to escalate appropriately and ensure timely resolution of complex incidents.

• Self-driven to explore new technologies, tools, and methodologies that enhance support capabilities and align with evolving business needs.

Pay Range: $30.00-35.00/hr
The actual offer may vary dependent upon geographic location and the candidate’s years of experience and/or skill level.
We are accepting applications for this position until a candidate has been selected. To apply to this position and learn more about open jobs at Marathon Health , visit our careers page.

- Contribute to multiple revision cycles based on internal technical acceptance criteria (e.g., validation, performance, robustness, system integration).

- Triage, troubleshoot, and root cause map-related disengagement issues

- Provide structured feedback to improve internal tooling, workflows, and mapping specifications.

REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years of experience in map creation and maintenance, ideally in a relevant field such as autonomous vehicle mapping, GIS, or 3D game design

- Bachelor's Degree or higher education

- A strong understanding of lane-level geometry at CM precision, routing, and HD (High-Definition) map structures used in autonomous driving.

- Experience working with point cloud data, 3D visualization environments, or lidar-based annotation tools

- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow precise digitization protocols

- Comfortable with repetitive, accuracy-focused tasks and versioned map delivery

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Familiarity with autonomous vehicle maps, AV datasets, or HD mapping pipelines

- Background in HD map pipelines for AV systems,

ABOUT EXPERIENCE BY INDUSTRIOUS

Experience by Industrious is a workplace hospitality brand launched by CBRE - built on the idea that where you work should actually feel like somewhere worth showing up to. We combine CBRE's real estate scale with Industrious' operating model to run dedicated experience teams across office assets, enterprise headquarters, healthcare facilities, and logistics centers worldwide.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You're the reason tenants feel like they belong to something. Not just a building, but a community - one with its own energy, its own rituals, and a sense that someone actually cares about how their days go.

As a Senior Community Manager, you design and oversee the full tenant programming experience: from the annual event calendar to day-of execution, from building communications to the tenant app. You lead the team that brings it all to life, and you're accountable for the engagement numbers that show it's working.

This role requires the creativity to design programs people actually want to attend, the operational discipline to run them well, and the relationship skills to make tenants feel personally connected to the building. The programming is the vehicle. The feeling is the product.

At buildings where this role works well, tenants renew leases partly because of what you've built. That's the bar.

WINNING IN THIS ROLE MEANS

• Tenants show up. Event attendance is strong, app engagement is growing, and the building has a reputation for actually doing things worth coming to.

• Tenant relationships feel personal. People know your name, tell you things, and trust that you'll follow through.

• Building communications are consistent, on-brand, and actually read. The app, signage, and newsletter work together as one voice.

• NPS and tenant satisfaction scores are trending upward, and you can trace them back to specific programs and decisions.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS ROLE AND SUCCEED AT IT IF

• You get energy from making people feel seen and connected. It's not just about organizing events. It's about noticing who's new, who needs an introduction, who's been having a rough week - and doing something about it.

• You're equally comfortable with strategy and execution. You can think through a quarterly programming calendar and then personally staff a Thursday afternoon activation. Both feel important to you.

• You understand that community doesn't happen by accident. You've built programs that worked and ones that didn't, and you learned from both. You have a framework for what drives engagement and why.

• You lead through relationships, not authority. Your direct reports work hard because they want to, not because you've told them to. You invest in people and it shows.

• You're genuinely curious about your tenants. You know what companies are in your building, what they're working on, what they care about. That knowledge makes your programming better and your relationships stickier.

NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

• You'd rather stay behind the scenes than be the face of a program. This role requires daily visibility and genuine warmth in person.

• You find the detail work (signage, supply checks, survey follow-up) more frustrating than fulfilling.

• Predictable routines appeal to you more than dynamic, fast-moving days.

• People management (coaching, feedback, performance conversations) feels like a distraction from your real work. Here, it is part of your real work.

• You don't see community programming as central to building value. Here, it's one of the primary drivers of tenant retention.

WHAT YOU OWN

Community programming and building communications:

• Design and execute a dynamic calendar of tenant events focused on values that build community and engagement.

• Manage all aspects of community events including budgeting, vendor management, onsite execution, and reporting.

• Manage event marketing including updating the tenant app, digital and physical signage, and the buildin

description:
ABOUT CARTESIA

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring an Analytics Engineer to build and own Cartesia's company-wide source of truth. You'll bring together product, billing, CRM, marketing, and operational data into reliable models and shared metric definitions that teams can trust.

This is an early, foundational data hire. You'll fix urgent correctness issues, strengthen the warehouse and transformation layer, and create the first trusted dashboards for Product, GTM, Growth, RevOps, and leadership. The goal is not simply to answer questions-it is to build the systems, models, and standards that let the company answer them consistently.

YOUR IMPACT

- Own the path from source systems to canonical datasets, metrics, and dashboards.

- Identify and fix data-quality issues across pipelines, models, definitions, and reporting surfaces.

- Build and maintain reliable warehouse models using SQL and dbt or equivalent tooling.

- Establish clear metric definitions, tests, lineage, freshness monitoring, documentation, and ownership.

- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, RevOps, Growth, and GTM to translate business concepts into durable data models.

- Create trusted dashboards for core company metrics such as activation, usage, billing, customer health, and marketing performance.

- Make common data questions self-serve while ensuring dashboards reuse canonical logic rather than duplicating it.

- Audit the existing data stack and recommend pragmatic improvements or overhauls to ETL and analytics tooling where needed.

- Educate the company on how to use the source of truth and how new metrics and dashboards should be created.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a technically rigorous analytics role, ideally at a B2B SaaS or developer-tools company.

- Expert SQL and strong warehouse modeling fundamentals, including dimensional modeling, historization, and identity resolution.

- Production experience with dbt or similar transformation tooling, plus testing, orchestration, monitoring, lineage, and documentation.

- A track record of turning fragmented data and competing definitions into canonical, reusable models.

- Experience working across product, billing, CRM, and marketing data; self-serve funnel experience is especially valuable.

- Strong judgment about when a problem belongs in a source system, pipeline, warehouse model, semantic layer, or dashboard.

- The ability to investigate discrepancies end-to-end and prevent them from recurring-not just patch the final report.

- Strong stakeholder instincts and the ability to make ambiguous business concepts precise.

- A practical, low-ego approach: willing to fix urgent issues while building toward a durable foundation.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience as an early or founding member of a data function.

- Experience with full-funnel growth analytics, attribution, channel ROI, CRM, billing, or self-serve conversion.

- Experience building self-serve data workflows or using LLM-powered analytics tooling.

NOT REQUIRED

- Machine learning, predictive modeling, or traditional data science experience. This is an analytics

At Genesys , we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Associate, Enterprise Change Management
Let’s be honest-traditional change management isn’t enough anymore.
AI is changing how work gets done. People and AI are working together in new ways. Technology is moving faster, customer expectations keep evolving, and businesses need to be able to adapt just as quickly.
At Genesys , we think that creates an exciting opportunity to rethink change.
We’re building the next evolution of change -moving beyond managing change one project at a time to creating a connected approach that helps our people and our business continuously adapt and thrive.
That means creating great change experiences for employees, helping leaders confidently lead their teams through change, using AI and data to better understand what people need, and staying focused on whether our work is actually delivering the outcomes we set out to achieve.
We call this the Genesys Way of Change -our modern approach to making transformation happen. It’s human-centered, intelligent, connected, and always evolving. We’re not interested in simply applying yesterday’s change playbooks to tomorrow’s challenges. We want to learn, experiment, use new technology, and find better ways to help people and the business adapt faster and turn change into meaningful results.
As an Associate, Enterprise Change Management , you’ll help bring this vision to life.
Working alongside our Enterprise Change Management team and partners across Genesys , you’ll help create and deliver change experiences that enable our people to understand what’s changing, adapt quickly, and thrive in new ways of working. You’ll help us understand how change is landing, turn data and feedback into insights, experiment with AI and new approaches, and build the tools and practices that will shape how change happens across Genesys .
If you’re curious about people, excited by how AI is changing the workplace, and want to learn how transformation really happens inside a global company, this is an opportunity to help us build what comes next.
What You’ll Do

• Support design/development of change experiences and execute change activities for assigned initiatives or workstreams, coordinating milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables to support successful adoption

• Develop communications, learning materials, engagement activities, presentations, toolkits, change champion networks, and other tactics and activities that help employees understand and adopt new ways of working

• Share ideas, feedback, and lessons learned that improve team practices and contribute to the continued evolution of the Genesys Way of Change

What You’ll Bring

• 2+ years of experience in organizational change management, employee communications, or learning and enablement. Familiarity with established organizational change methodologies, tools, and practices

description:
Position Summary

The Product Security Analyst supports NETGEAR's vulnerability management and product security incident response function. This role triages and scores reported vulnerabilities, verifies proof-of-concept exploits against NETGEAR products and services, applies AI-assisted tooling to accelerate security code review, and works with engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle to close out findings. The ideal candidate combines hands-on offensive security skills with the judgment to communicate risk clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• CVSS Scoring & Triage: Score and triage reported vulnerabilities using the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS), producing consistent, defensible base, temporal, and environmental scores and prioritizing intake accordingly.

• Vulnerability Verification & PoC Review: Independently verify reported vulnerabilities, reproduce and validate proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit code, and assess real-world exploitability and impact on NETGEAR products and services.

• AI-Assisted Security Analysis: Apply AI-assisted tools and techniques to explore and analyze security issues, including AI-augmented static/dynamic code analysis, to speed up root-cause identification and coverage of complex codebases.

• Penetration Testing Tools: Use a range of penetration testing and security assessment tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, static/dynamic analysis suites) to evaluate firmware, web, cloud, and mobile attack surfaces.

• SDLC Engagement: Partner with engineering throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to embed security requirements, review designs and code, and validate remediations before release.

Required Qualifications

• Solid understanding of CVSS (v3.1 or later) and demonstrated ability to score and prioritize vulnerabilities consistently.

• Hands-on experience reproducing and validating vulnerability reports and proof-of-concept exploits.

• Working knowledge of applying AI/LLM-based tools to security code analysis or vulnerability research.

• Practical familiarity with common penetration testing tools and methodologies (web, network, and/or firmware).

• Experience working within a formal Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including secure design and code review practices.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with embedded/IoT or networking product security (routers, gateways, or similar consumer or enterprise devices).

• Familiarity with vulnerability disclosure processes and coordinated disclosure (PSIRT) workflows.

• Scripting ability (Python, Bash, or similar) to automate triage and verification tasks.

description:
ABOUT TRADEIFY FX

Tradeify is a fast-growing futures trading company built to help traders access the tools, technology, and opportunities they need to succeed. We combine a trader-first approach with modern technology to create a reliable, transparent, and engaging experience for our growing community.

Tradeify FX is our new team focused on the forex market, bringing that same approach to a global FX audience. We operate at the intersection of finance and technology, and we move quickly.

THE OPPORTUNITY

You'll run day-to-day social media for the Tradeify FX launch, creating content, engaging with our community, and helping grow our presence among FX traders across major platforms. This role matters right now because the first months will shape how the FX trading world sees us.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career who is eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Content and Publishing

- Execute the social media plan for Tradeify FX across X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, and LinkedIn

- Manage and maintain a content calendar covering education, market commentary, product announcements, trader spotlights, and promotions

- Create and publish short-form video, graphics, carousels, and written posts, working with designers and editors as needed

- Keep an eye on trends, competitors, and market events to spot timely content ideas

Community

- Help build and moderate an active FX trading community on Discord and Telegram, responding to comments, DMs, and questions quickly and on-brand

- Support collaborations with traders, influencers, and affiliates

Performance and Collaboration

- Familiarity with scheduling and analytics tools (such as Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Buffer, or Metricool) and native platform analytics

- Willingness to learn financial marketing rules, including avoiding profit guarantees and including appropriate risk disclosures

- Comfort working in fast-moving, high-volume community spaces like Discord and Telegram

- Ability to work independently, prioritize, and hit deadlines

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with influencer or affiliate programs

- Video editing or motion graphics skills (CapCut, Premiere, After Effects)

- Exposure to paid social on Meta, X, or YouTube

- Personal trading experience or involvement in trading communities

- Experience in fintech, crypto, or financial services

WHY JOIN TRADEIFY

- Join a rapidly growing trading company at an exciting stage of its development, and help launch its new FX team

- Get real ownership of day-to-day social for a brand-new division

- Gain exposure to brand, product, community, and growth work instead of being limited to one area

- Ship frequently and see the direct impact of your work across the business

- Learn from experienced marketers and senior team members while developing greater ownership and independence

- Work in a remote-friendly, fast-moving environment

- Receive competitive compensation and benefits

- Help shape the experience of Tradeify's growing community of traders

Social Media Executive

The Social Executive will support Biffa ’s day-to-day social media activity, creating and delivering engaging, audience-focused content across priority platforms.
Working within the Strategic Communications team, the role will support strategic communications and integrated campaigns by creating, publishing and optimising social content that supports Biffa ’s reputation, growth and community engagement objectives.
The role will manage the social content calendar, working closely with the Head of Strategic Communications and Strategic Communications Manager, Press & Media Officer, Community Executive, divisional marketing teams and subject matter experts to maximise reach and engagement.
The Social Executive will monitor channel performance, identify opportunities to improve content and engagement, support real-time communications and provide insight to inform future campaigns.
The ideal candidate will be a confident social content creator with strong knowledge of social platforms, audience engagement and digital communications, able to produce a range of content and collaborate effectively across the business and with external partners.
Key responsibilities:

• Manage day-to-day activity across Biffa 's owned social media channels, ensuring content is published accurately, consistently and in line with agreed plans and calendars.

• Create, edit, adapt and schedule compelling social content across priority social platforms, ensuring it is optimised for the targeted audiences and channels to drive reach and engagement.

• Support the delivery of integrated strategic communications and broader campaigns through the creation and distribution of social content

• Repurpose content (where relevant) across social channels and formats to maximise reach, engagement and value from communications activity.

• Maintain and manage the social calendar, ensuring activity aligns with strategic communications priorities, campaigns and business objectives.

• Work with internal stakeholders and subject matter experts to identify proactive and planned social content opportunities, gather information and create engaging social assets.

• Support the creation and coordination of photography, video, graphics and multimedia for use in social channels through internal resources and external suppliers where required.

Essential criteria for the role:

• Degree-level education or equivalent experience in communications, marketing, journalism, digital media or a related discipline.

• Previously worked on social media channels for a corporate or agency in a B2B environment.

• Creating content across a range of social media platforms.

• Supporting integrated communications, marketing or content campaigns.

• Experience using social media scheduling, publishing and analytics platforms.

• Experience working with multiple stakeholders and managing competing priorities

参画いただく可能性のあるプロジェクト例

- サポートサービスチーム、エンジニアリング、プロダクトマネジメントと緊密に連携し、ユーザーやお客様に必要とされる機能の定義に貢献する

そして、もちろん以下も担います

- フロントラインのエンジニア、そしてClickHouseの代表として、優れたカスタマーサービスを提供します。当社のサポートエンジニアは、チケットシステム、メール、Slack、電話などで受け付けた技術的なケースに対し、所定のサービスレベルアグリーメント(「SLA」)の範囲内で、プロフェッショナルな対応、オンコール対応、およびガイダンスを提供します

求めるスキル・経験

- グローバルに分散した環境で高品質な24時間365日のサポートを提供するために必要な、勤務スケジュールおよび出張(現地訪問)に対応でき、対応可能であること

- チームワーク、グローバルな視点での関わり、共感力、そして困難な課題を解決する姿勢

- 世界で最もスケーラブルで、最高性能かつ最大規模、最速のデータベースを構築することに対する冒険心と切迫感

あればなお歓迎

確認・調整メモ

- 原文の軽微な修正点(英語側): 「locared」は「located」の誤記と解釈しました。また「support team … who provides」は、チームなので「that provides」が自然です。

title: Customer Service Specialist - GA
description:
This is a remote position.
We are looking for energetic individuals that have an interest in providing our clients/customers with excellent customer service from your secured home office.
​
Requirements

• Must speak English fluently.

• Be able to type 40 words per minute or greater;

• High-speed DSL or cable connection rated at least 10 MB download speed and 2 MB upload speed.

• Dedicated home office space, which is free from distraction, and with a door that can be closed and locked. We will ask you to provide a picture of this space. Your workspace must be a dedicated working environment that is used exclusively by you.

• A personal desktop computer running a licensed version of Windows 10 or higher (Windows 11 preferred), with 8 GB of RAM (Core i3 processor, or better). Laptops are not eligible for the work-at-home agent program.

• A 19″ flat panel monitor (minimum), multiple displays recommended and preferred.

• A webcam, for training, compliance, and collaboration purposes.

• A wired network connection (wireless is not permitted).

• An approved-brand USB headset for VOIP

• A modern mobile phone (iOS or Android) that can be used for multi-factor authentication purposes. Must have iOS 17 or greater, or Android OS 12 or greater. Apple or Samsung brand preferred.

Benefits

Everyone needs time to relax and enjoy life - and at XACT , we’re firm believers in work-life balance. Our paid time off (PTO) program allows team members to earn time they can use to unwind and enjoy life outside of work.

Although we’re open 24 hours a day, we believe in flexible scheduling that integrates work into your life - not the other way around. Set schedules, split shifts, and on-demand shift availability are just a few of the options we offer.

Full-time team members are eligible to join our company group plan through Aetna, once eligibility requirements are met.

Smile confidently!

XACT offers dental insurance through Sun Life to eligible team members. With both low- and high-benefit plan options, you’ll find one that fits your needs and makes you grin.

We see you, too!

We proudly offer VSP vision insurance to eligible team members. With strong coverage and savings on glasses and contacts, it's easy to see the value.

In addition to standard insurance options, we also provide supplemental products through Allstate - including accident, disability, and other coverage choices.

Relax - it’s expected.

We’re happy to provide safe, comfortable working environments designed with your well-being in mind. Our call centers feature employee lounges, quiet spaces, and cozy places to work.

We’re just one big family here, so pull up a seat and join in. As a team member - not an independent contractor - you can count on us for support. Whether you’re working in our contact centers or from your home office, we’ll equip you with the tools, technology, and 24×7 support you need to succeed.

title: Associate Director, Commerce
Federal Proposal Manager (Contract) - Bethesda, MD
description:
Engagement type: Independent consultant, 1099 hourly.
Rate range: $100 - $500 per hour, based on experience and scope (three-tier band detailed below).
Time commitment: Project-based, scales with proposal volume.
Location: Fully remote.
Reports to: GovCon Division Lead, with dotted line to the Federal Capture Director.
A note from the founder
A great proposal is the difference between a captured opportunity and an awarded contract. We have the capture motion ramping up. We need the operator who turns the captured opportunity into a compliant, compelling, on-time response, and who builds the response library so every future proposal moves faster than the last.
What is already built
The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt.
Bench credentials: Former EEOC Administrative Law Judge, employment attorneys (JD, MBA), clinical advisors, 32-year enterprise operations specialist. 47 combined years HHS experience.
What you own

• Full proposal lifecycle: kickoff, compliance matrix, schedule, color-team reviews (pink, red, gold), production, submission

• Technical writing and editing across executive summary, technical approach, management approach, past performance, and resumes of key personnel

• Compliance matrix ownership: every shall, every Section L and M requirement, every page count, every font and margin spec

• Response library build: past performance citations, key personnel resumes, technical narratives, reusable management approach modules, pricing structures

• Coordination with the Federal Capture Director on win themes, discriminators, and ghosting strategy

• Coordination with subcontractor partners on teaming inputs and price submissions

• Post-submission tracking, debrief capture, and lessons-learned documentation

Engagement structure
Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

•
Writer ($100-175/hr): Proposal writers and coordinators with 3-7 years federal proposal experience

•
Manager ($175-325/hr): Proposal managers with documented win history and full-lifecycle ownership

•
Principal ($325-500/hr): Senior proposal directors with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Per-proposal scope and budget defined at proposal kickoff. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for proposals that result in awarded contracts.
Success milestones

•
First 60 days: Proposal process documented. Compliance matrix template built. Response library framework established with 5+ reusable past performance citations.

•
First 120 days: First 1-2 proposals submitted on time, compliant, and competitive. Color-team review cadence established.

•
First 180 days: 3-5 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Response library covers 80% of TWF's standard content needs.

Who you are

• 5-15 years in federal proposal management, technical writing, or capture support

• Documented track record managing $1M+ federal proposals through full lifecycle to submission

• Shipley-trained or equivalent. APMP credential preferred

• Fluent in FAR/DFARS, RFP structure (Sections L and M), and compliance matrix methodology

• Strong writing voice: clear, persuasive, and adaptable across technical and management content

• Comfortable working both as lead writer and as orchestrator of subject matter expert input

• Past performance citations in workforce services, HHS programs, hospitality contracting, or staffing IDIQs preferred

• Located anywhere in the US

Bonus points

• Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique proposal shop
